emily_cs: NimbusPay flagged a rerank regression after yesterday's runtime model bump (rerank-v3.2). They say same inputs -> different ordering and score deltas ~0.15. Customer example attached.

alex_support: Can you paste the exact request/response they used?

emily_cs: Sure, here's the request id and payload they provided at 2024-11-05T16:02:10Z

emily_cs: ```curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"refund status for invoice 89234","candidates":["We issued a refund","No refund needed","Refund pending"],"top_k":3, "temperature":0, "normalize_scores":true}'```

emily_cs: Customer pasted two outputs (they saved responses before deploy):
Before (rerank-v3.1.9): [0.02, 0.85, 0.13]
After (rerank-v3.2.0): [0.76, 0.12, 0.12]

jordan_ml: Those deltas are huge. Any chance they altered preprocessing (tokenization, case)?

emily_cs: Customer insists payload identical. They also included 'temperature':0 and 'normalize_scores':true in both calls.

sam_eng: deploy-bot shows model rollout at 2024-11-05T15:58:03Z: rerank-v3.2.0 -> kernel opt/kv patch. Pinged infra to check quantization flags.

deploy-bot: Deployed rerank-v3.2.0 to hosted pool us-west-2 (canary 10%).

maria_sre: I'll pull logs for that request-id, what's the request id from customer?

emily_cs: req_acc: rq_20241105_842

maria_sre: Found logs: request routed to canary instance host-rw-12, model rerank-v3.2.0, runtime flagged quant_mode=dynamic, tokenization=v1. No auth failures, latency 120ms.

sam_eng: Could be post-processing normalization bug — v3.2 swapped to L2 normalization for scores when normalize_scores=true but rounding changed threshold. Repro locally.

jordan_ml: Try reproducing with exact payload and headers including 'accept-encoding' and 'client-token' header, maybe they used older SDK that modifies candidate order.

emily_cs: Customer attached SDK version: redwood-js 0.9.4. We suspect canonicalization change.

sam_eng: Quick repro on local with redwood-js 0.9.4 + rerank-v3.2.0 => reproduced score flip. Root cause: a change in score scaling after an optimization removed softmax temp clamp. Fix: reintroduce clamp in postprocess when normalize_scores is true.

alex_support: ETA for patch? Customer is on a paid Dedicated plan.

sam_eng: I'll push hotfix v3.2.1 to canary in 20 min, will monitor score metric. Prep rollback if bad.

emily_cs: I'll inform NimbusPay and ask for samples across their top 20 queries to compare.

maria_sre: Noted. Tagging incident tracker INC-2024-8923 :eyes: 

emily_cs: Thanks all :heart:
